incidents.text: Goal! Cody Gakpo passes the ball to the feet of Brian Brobbey (Netherlands), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 1:0.
It's 2:0! Denzel Dumfries feeds Brian Brobbey (Netherlands) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the bottom left corner.
Ronald Koeman has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) comes on the pitch for Donyell Malen.
Goal! Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Denzel Dumfries. The score is 3:0.
Gabriel Gudmundsson (Sweden) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
Goal! Cody Gakpo (Netherlands) is teed up on the edge of the box by Crysencio Summerville, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom left corner gives the keeper no chance. 4:0.
The referee signals a substitution. Anthony Elanga (Sweden) is brought on as a substitute for Alexander Bernhardsson.
It is time for a substitution. Besfort Zeneli (Sweden) is on for Jesper Karlstrom.
Graham Potter prepares a substitution. Benjamin Nygren is replaced by Lucas Bergvall (Sweden).

Goal! Alexander Isak puts Anthony Elanga (Sweden) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the left side of the goal. 4:1.
Today's match ends for Frenkie de Jong who will be replaced by Teun Koopmeiners (Netherlands).
Ronald Koeman has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Guus Til (Netherlands) replacing Tijjani Reijnders.
The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Brian Brobbey departs the field of play to be replaced by Memphis Depay (Netherlands).
Yasin Ayari (Sweden) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
Substitution. Taha Ali (Sweden) in, Yasin Ayari out.
Lucas Bergvall (Sweden) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
Goal - 5:1! Crysencio Summerville (Netherlands) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Memphis Depay provided an assist for the goal.
Here's the change. Cody Gakpo leaves the pitch and Noa Lang (Netherlands) comes on as a substitute.
It's time for a substitution. Elliot Stroud (Sweden) comes on in place of Gabriel Gudmundsson.
